nodes:
  CONFIG_ETH_STM32_HAL:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/ethernet/Kconfig.stm32_hal:7
    depends_on_expr: DT_HAS_ST_STM32_ETHERNET_ENABLED && ETH_DRIVER
    selects:
    - CONFIG_USE_STM32_HAL_ETH
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    - CONFIG_HWINFO
    - CONFIG_PINCTRL
    - CONFIG_NET_CHECKSUM_OFFLOAD_SUPPORTED
    implies:
    - CONFIG_NVMEM
    - CONFIG_CRC
    help: 'Enable STM32 HAL based Ethernet driver. It is available for

      all Ethernet enabled variants of the F2, F4, F7 and H7 series.'
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_INTEL_ADSP:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - soc/intel/intel_adsp/Kconfig.soc:6
    - soc/intel/intel_adsp/Kconfig:6

    - CONFIG_ARCH_SUPPORTS_COREDUMP
    - CONFIG_CPU_HAS_DCACHE
    - CONFIG_CPU_HAS_ICACHE
    - CONFIG_CPU_CACHE_INCOHERENT
    - CONFIG_CACHE_CAN_SAY_MEM_COHERENCE
    - CONFIG_SOC_HAS_CACHE_FUNCTIONS

    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    - CONFIG_DYNAMIC_INTERRUPTS
    implies:
    - CONFIG_UDC_BUF_FORCE_NOCACHE
    - CONFIG_UDC_WORKQUEUE
    help: NXP MCUX USB Device Controller Driver for EHCI.
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_WDT_NXP_S32:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/watchdog/Kconfig.nxp_s32:4
    depends_on_expr: DT_HAS_NXP_S32_SWT_ENABLED && WATCHDOG
    selects:
    - CONFIG_CLOCK_CONTROL
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    help: Enable the Software Watchdog Timer (SWT) driver.
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_DMA_MCUX_EDMA:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/dma/Kconfig.mcux_edma:10
    depends_on_expr: n
    implies:
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    help: DMA version 2 driver for MCUX series SoCs with EDMA IP.
    domain: Kconfig
  DTS_memory@80000000:
    type: hardware_node
    status: okay
    properties:
    - device_type
    - reg
    domain: DTS
  CONFIG_ETH_NXP_ENET:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/ethernet/Kconfig.nxp_enet:9

    selects:
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY

    - CONFIG_PINCTRL
    - CONFIG_HWINFO

    implies:
    - CONFIG_NET_POWER_MANAGEMENT
    - CONFIG_NVMEM

    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_UHC_NXP_EHCI:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/usb/uhc/Kconfig.mcux:4
    depends_on_expr: DT_HAS_NXP_UHC_EHCI_ENABLED && UHC_DRIVER
    selects:
    - CONFIG_EVENTS
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    - CONFIG_DYNAMIC_INTERRUPTS
    help: NXP MCUX USB Host Controller Driver for EHCI.
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_ETH_SAM_GMAC:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - boards/shields/esp_8266/boards/sam4e_xpro.defconfig:11
    - drivers/ethernet/Kconfig.sam_gmac:6
    depends_on_expr: NET_BUF_FIXED_DATA_SIZE && (DT_HAS_ATMEL_SAM_GMAC_ENABLED ||
      DT_HAS_ATMEL_SAM0_GMAC_ENABLED) && ETH_DRIVER
    selects:
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    - CONFIG_PINCTRL
    implies:
    - CONFIG_NVMEM
    help: Enable Atmel SAM MCU Family Ethernet driver.
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_TRACING:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - subsys/tracing/Kconfig:8
    depends_on_expr: y
    selects:
    - CONFIG_INSTRUMENT_THREAD_SWITCHING
    implies:
    - CONFIG_THREAD_NAME
    - CONFIG_THREAD_STACK_INFO
    - CONFIG_THREAD_MONITOR
    help: 'Enable system tracing. This requires a backend such as SEGGER

      Systemview to be enabled as well.'
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_MIN_HEAP:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - lib/min_heap/Kconfig:4
    depends_on_expr: y
    help: 'Enable support for a generic Min-Heap data structure library.


      A Min-Heap is a binary tree-based data structure in which the

      smallest element is always at the root. It supports efficient

      insertion and removal of the minimum element in O(log...'
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_NXP_S32_SPI:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/spi/Kconfig.nxp_s32:4
    depends_on_expr: DT_HAS_NXP_S32_SPI_ENABLED && SPI
    selects:
    - CONFIG_PINCTRL
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    help: Enable support for NXP S32 SPI driver.
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_ETH_XLNX_GEM:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/ethernet/Kconfig.xlnx_gem:9
    depends_on_expr: DT_HAS_XLNX_GEM_ENABLED && (!QEMU_TARGET || (QEMU_TARGET && NET_QEMU_ETHERNET))
      && ETH_DRIVER
    selects:
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    - CONFIG_CACHE_MANAGEMENT
    - CONFIG_NET_CHECKSUM_OFFLOAD_SUPPORTED
    help: Enable Xilinx GEM Ethernet driver.
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - soc/mediatek/mt8xxx/Kconfig.defconfig:43
    - arch/Kconfig:455
    depends_on_expr: SOC_FAMILY_MTK || ARCH_HAS_NOCACHE_MEMORY_SUPPORT
    help: 'Add a "nocache" read-write memory section that is configured to

      not be cached. This memory section can be used to perform DMA

      transfers when cache coherence issues are not optimal or can not

      be solved using cache maintenance operations.'
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_MEMORY_WIN_0_SIZE:
    type: int
    defined_at:
    - soc/intel/intel_adsp/Kconfig:48
    depends_on_expr: SOC_FAMILY_INTEL_ADSP
    help: 'Size of memory window 0.


      This window is used for firmware status & outbox/uplink mbox.'
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_SHARED_MULTI_HEAP:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - lib/heap/Kconfig:218
    depends_on_expr: y
    selects:
    - CONFIG_MULTI_HEAP
    help: 'Enable support for a shared multi-heap manager that uses the

      multi-heap allocator to manage a set of reserved memory regions with

      different capabilities / attributes (cacheable, non-cacheable,

      etc...) defined in the DT.'
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_MULTI_HEAP:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - lib/heap/Kconfig:207
    depends_on_expr: y
    help: 'Allows multiple sys_heap regions to be unified under a single

      allocation API.  Sometimes apps need the ability to share multiple

      discontiguous regions in a single "heap", or

      to have memory of different "types" be allocated heuristically bas...'
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_TRACING_HEAP:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - subsys/tracing/Kconfig:311
    depends_on_expr: TRACING
    help: Enable tracing Memory Heaps.
    domain: Kconfig
  CONFIG_ETH_NUMAKER:
    type: bool
    defined_at:
    - drivers/ethernet/Kconfig.numaker:6
    depends_on_expr: DT_HAS_NUVOTON_NUMAKER_ETHERNET_ENABLED && ETH_DRIVER
    selects:
    - CONFIG_HAS_NUMAKER_ETH
    - CONFIG_PINCTRL
    - CONFIG_NOCACHE_MEMORY
    help: 'This option enables the Ethernet driver for Nuvoton NuMaker family of

      processors.

      Say y if you wish to enable NuMaker ETH.'
    domain: Kconfig
